_comment: Language Pack registry (Plan §3.2). Adding a language = adding an entry here. Never a code change.

asr._baseline_note: Stock Whisper. Strong on Kenyan-accented English.
asr._initial_prompt_note: MEASURED AND REJECTED 2026-10-07. Priming the decoder with a short in-language, in-register prompt made output markedly WORSE on real broadcast audio: Kikuyu diacritics collapsed (37 -> 1 on one 60s segment, 32 -> 0 for Dholuo), text degenerated into character soup, and output shortened by up to 65%. avg_logprob improved while the text got worse - confident-when-wrong, exactly what CLAUDE.md 2.4 warns of. The wiring is kept and defaults to no prompt. Re-test against the frozen reference set before setting this, and have a native speaker write the text: the rejected prompts were machine-written and may themselves have been malformed.

orthography._note: Dholuo tone is unwritten — a known WER ceiling (Plan §4.5). ATR/vowel-harmony spelling varies across sources; normalise before scoring or WER measures spelling, not recognition.

models._comment: Physical model artefacts. Pack -> model_ref -> this table. The indirection is what lets Step 2 swap in trained adapters without touching code.

paza-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2._note: Paza adds non-standard Whisper language tokens. The converter must preserve the full tokenizer.
paza-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2._size_note: download_size_gb is the fp32 safetensors on the hub; approx_size_gb is the converted int8 artefact on disk. They differ ~2x — budget download time against the former.

nllb-200-distilled-1.3B-ct2._licence_note: NON-COMMERCIAL. Fine-tuned derivatives inherit it. Acceptable for the POC; must be decided before Step 2.
nllb-200-distilled-1.3B-ct2._note: Text-to-text only: vernacular transcript -> English. Never sees audio. Loaded in its own pool slot, beside (not instead of) the ASR model.

translation._comment: Pipeline-wide translation settings. Per-language enablement is packs[].translation.model_ref. A pack may override any check under packs[].translation.checks.

checks._note: Flagged English is stored but withheld from documents and exports until reviewed. Calibrate against real output; these are starting values, not measured ones.

future_packs._comment: Phase 2 targets. Listed to keep the registry honest about what it must scale to. Not active.
